description: Works out a price for one service job: cost = hours x hourly pay + materials + travel + monthly overhead / jobs per month; price = cost / (1 - profit margin). Also returns profit per job, monthly revenue and break-even jobs per month. Same formula as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/price-per-job-calculator.html. Margins above 95% are treated as 95%.

hourly_rate.description: Your pay per hour in USD.

jobs_per_month.description: Jobs expected per month; the overhead is shared across them. Default 0.

materials.description: Materials per job in USD. Default 0.

monthly_overhead.description: Monthly overhead (insurance, phone, software, ...) in USD. Default 0.

profit_margin_percent.description: Profit margin as a percent of the price, for example 20.

travel.description: Travel cost per job in USD. Default 0.

name: calculate_price_per_job
title: Calculate price per job
